## Verification

Describe what was checked and the observed result. For gameplay include Unity version, scene, and reproduction steps. For art include preview, dimensions, and import settings. List anything untested.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope matches the agreed task and GDD, or the proposed design change is explained.
- [ ] Relevant checks and remaining limitations are recorded.
- [ ] No generated folders or credentials are included.
- [ ] Unity assets include their matching `.meta` files, if applicable.
- [ ] New assets have author and license information, if applicable.
- [ ] Documentation reflects any setup or design changes.
